summary: Iteration 127 depth-testing of TeamNest.ai model presets + invite analytics + pending-invites UX on WEB + MOBILE with the shared FastAPI backend. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases PASS (1 skipped because os@radciti.com temp password expired) — presets seed (Deep dive / Fast / Research), create/dup-name/name-length/model-count/model-key/delete + role gating, /api/workspace/members returns status+joined_at+last_invite_sent_at, /api/workspace/invite-analytics returns configured=true with status='sent' for the pending 'Tracker QA' member and honors 60s cache flag, /api/ai/models advertises gpt-5.6-sol / claude-sonnet-5 / claude-opus-4-8. Web /team ✅: Sam T = 'Joined ✓ 6/24/2026', Tracker QA = 'Invited · 8m ago' + 'Sent' Mailgun badge + Resend button — tapping Resend fires POST /api/workspace/invite/{id}/resend and shows the sonner toast 'Invitation re-sent to e1-track-…@teamnest.ai'. Web presets ✅: typing '@ai …' + Enter opens the AI model picker with a 'Presets' bar showing the 3 seeded chips; Save captures current selection as new preset (chip appears live); delete-X removes it. Mobile /team ✅ (Expo web preview): identical Joined/Invited/Sent + Resend flash toast + team-invite-btn opens invite modal. Mobile presets ❌ BLOCKED by a runtime crash: opening the inline @ai model picker on any chat throws 'pickerHint is not defined' at /app/mobile/app/chat/[id].tsx:1269 — the picker (and therefore the mobile ModelPresetBar embedded in it) can't render at all. AiComposeModal.tsx path is coded correctly (own state), so preset UI in the Ask-AI compose modal should still work, but the primary '@ai in chat' picker is broken on mobile — this must be fixed before parity claims. Everything else looks solid.

minor.issue: Test-account member login returns 403 'Your temporary password has expired' — blocks member-role gating tests. Not a code bug; the provisioned temp password TTL elapsed. Re-provision or reset before next iteration if member-role coverage is needed.

issues: Chip label renders 'Deep dive· 2' with no space before the middle-dot separator (missing space in template literal `${p.name}· ${p.models.length}` in /app/frontend/src/components/ai_composer/ModelPresetBar.jsx:76). Purely cosmetic.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime crash 'pickerHint is not defined' when the picker opens (typing @ai then Send/Enter) — /app/mobile/app/chat/[id].tsx:1269 references `pickerHint` in the ai-model-hint Text, and line 1244 calls `setPickerHint(m.key)` — but the corresponding useState pair was never declared. Blocks BOTH the model picker AND the mobile ModelPresetBar embedded within it on the primary '@ai in chat' path.

action_items: MOBILE CRITICAL: Add `const [pickerHint, setPickerHint] = useState<string | null>(null);` inside ChatScreen in /app/mobile/app/chat/[id].tsx (near the other picker state hooks) so line 1269 stops referencing an undeclared identifier. This unblocks the in-chat AI model picker AND the mobile ModelPresetBar embedded in it.

critical_code_review_comments: chat/[id].tsx is still ~1733 lines — the pickerHint miss is exactly the kind of drift that a split (extract PickerModal/PresetsBar wiring into its own component) would prevent.

team_tools.py DELETE preset endpoint deletes without checking is_default — a member could delete the seeded 'Deep dive/Fast/Research' presets if they were the (nonexistent) creator (created_by is None for defaults). Currently guarded because created_by==None will fail the equality with current['id'] AND non-admins hit 403 → safe, but consider explicitly `if preset.get('is_default') and not is_admin: raise 403` to future-proof.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter127 uncovered ONE critical mobile bug (pickerHint undefined in chat/[id].tsx line 1269 — crashes the @ai model picker on mobile) and ONE cosmetic web spacing issue. Backend + web /team + web AI picker presets + mobile /team all verified working. After the pickerHint fix, please re-run: (a) mobile chat @ai → send → picker opens without red-screen, (b) presets bar shows the 3 defaults, apply/save/delete on mobile, (c) cross-platform parity — a preset saved on mobile appears on web reload and vice versa (same workspace-shared collection). Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration127_team_tools.py is regression-safe and idempotent.
rca of the issue: Mobile @ai model picker crash: /app/mobile/app/chat/[id].tsx uses `pickerHint` at line 1269 and `setPickerHint` at line 1244, but the corresponding `useState` declaration is missing (only `pickerModels`, `pickerRemember` and friends are declared). This produces 'Uncaught Error: pickerHint is not defined' when the picker mounts, which happens as soon as the user types @ai and taps Send. Fix: declare `const [pickerHint, setPickerHint] = useState<string | null>(null);` alongside the other picker state hooks. Nothing else needs to change — AiComposeModal.tsx already declares its own `activeHint` locally so it is unaffected.
